consequence.statement: This is a documentation enhancement with no operational impact on running systems.

original.statement: Documentation for the --dns01-recursive-nameservers flag now includes an example for IPv6 usage.

decision.reason: [ev-7fdda4292ba5] lists this item only under the v1.17.0 Documentation section and says just that an IPv6 example was added for `--dns01-recursive-nameservers`. It says nothing about the flag's behavior changing, anything failing or anything being rejected. The consequence "none" (informational) fits the evidence, and all four proposals agree on it.
